title: Seventy Million, Always Behind
why: A year of campaign texts to one phone, read end to end instead of one at a time. Read singly they're unremarkable. Read as a body they show a channel that can only make one kind of claim about itself, and the claim never varies no matter what is actually happening.
hook: A Senate campaign told one supporter it was short of money fourteen times. Over the same stretch it raised seventy million dollars and broke a national record. Neither claim was false. So what was "behind" actually reporting?
